description: Election Commission - N. Karunanity was Elected as the Member of the Vavuniya Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Vavuniya Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority position, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent declaration of a new elected member to fill the vacancy. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for government bodies.
